transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable inherent `Vec<T, A>::extract_if` method, adapting the Rust elided return lifetime to an explicit Verus lifetime while preserving the generated RangeBounds precondition and `vec_extract_if_created` postcondition.
Extracted target-local `Vec { buf, len }`, `RawVec`, View, RangeBounds helper vocabulary, and `ExtractIf { vec, idx, end, del, old_len, pred }` field context from the frozen Rust 1.96 source shape.

Preserved the public target body as the single source delegation `ExtractIf::new(self, filter, range)`; the private constructor body keeps `old_len = vec.len()`, `slice::range(range, ..old_len)`, leak-amplification `vec.set_len(0)`, and the field initializer as the named source-backed boundary.

Recorded that `ExtractIf` stores the mutable Vec borrow and FnMut predicate while future iteration, drop hole-filling, and lifetime/drop-state behavior remain behind the generated iterator-adaptor relation instead of being strengthened into a unique final sequence.
